rationale: The assistant gave the right first checks (lint filter, hose kinks, run with the hose off). When the customer confirmed the crushed hose and the 40-minute run, it correctly identified the hose as the cause and advised a cheap replacement or straightening, telling the landlord and cleaning the filter. The mid-conversation recall detour was somewhat alarmist, and it asserted that IDV75 is in the recall without verification, but it advised checking the serial number rather than assuming. It also told the customer to stop using the dryer pending that check, which is cautious but reasonable.
